title: Query trace length under coordinate embedding
statement: Let $m,n$ be nonnegative integers, let $\Omega$ be a set of coordinate values, and let $\alpha$ be a set of leaf labels. Let $e:\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\to\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be an injective map, let $A$ be a finite set of coordinates among the first $m$ coordinates, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree over $\Omega$ with leaf labels in $\alpha$ and available coordinates $A$. For any input $x$ on the $n$ coordinates, the length of the query trace of the tree reindexed by $e$ equals the length of the query trace of $T$ on the input $i\mapsto x(e(i))$.
hypotheses_covered: $e$ is an injective map from the $m$ coordinates to the $n$ coordinates
$A$ is a finite set of coordinates among the first $m$ coordinates
$T$ is a finite decision tree over $\Omega$ with leaf labels in $\alpha$ and available coordinates $A$
$x$ assigns a value in $\Omega$ to each of the $n$ coordinates
